title: Guide health use of partial or absent foundational DPI
requirements:
- Give prominence to proceeding without waiting for foundational DPI
- Add how the health sector leverages foundational DPI as it emerges, rather than presuming absence
- State identity, payments and data exchange are principal, not exhaustive, categories
- Illustrate consent, longitudinal records and surveillance needs with country examples
- Require modular replacement boundaries, time-bound review and interoperability with future national services
- Require a documented transition path for interim health-sector substitutes
